description: This file defines the ProjectsController class, which provides REST API endpoints for managing projects. It includes actions for creating, updating, retrieving, partially updating, deleting projects, and fetching related data such as categories and secrets. The controller interacts with a database context and a Redis cache, handling typical CRUD operations along with some additional querying and caching logic.

classes.name: ProjectsController
classes.description: The main controller class handling all project-related API endpoints for creating, updating, retrieving, and deleting projects, as well as fetching related categories and secrets.

methods.name: CreateOne
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new project, setting the creator's user ID, saving to the database, and creating an initial project member record.

methods.name: UpdateOne
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing project identified by ID, setting new values while preserving the ID.

methods.name: PatchOne
methods.description: Handles PATCH requests to update the 'archived' status of a project asynchronously.

methods.name: GetMany
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a list of projects with optional filtering by status, keywords (cached in Redis), isTemplate, and clientId. Supports pagination.

methods.name: GetProjectCategories
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch all project categories ordered by name.

methods.name: GetOne
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve details of a specific project by ID, including related entities.

methods.name: DeleteOne
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a project by ID, with auditing.

methods.name: GetSecrets
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve secrets associated with a specific project.
